title: Aircraft type descriptions
description: What is true of an aircraft type wherever it flies, by type designator, each row citing its sources. Licensed under the Mozilla Public License 2.0 (https://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/). What a schema cannot say (that every source a row names is listed under `sources`, and that `checked-against` and `source-notes` name only the row's own sources) is checked when the crate is built.

schema-version.description: The version of this schema the file is written for. A reader refuses a version it does not know.

sources.description: Each source once, by an id the rows name it by.

designators.description: The rows, keyed by type designator.

not-to-be-used.description: Strings known not to be current designators, each with what replaces it.

designator.description: A type designator: not more than four characters (SKYbrary, Aircraft Type Designator), written here in capitals.

kind.description: What sort of source it is. A row is confirmed only when it has been checked against a type certificate data sheet.

revision.description: The revision or issue, and its date, as the source gives them. Left out when not yet checked.

notes.description: What is true of the source for every row that names it.

models.description: The manufacturer and models the designator covers.

airframe.description: The kind of airframe. `glider` and `airship` are additions to the letters of an aircraft description, so that a glider and an airship can be told apart.

engine-type.description: The kind of engine: `turboprop` covers a turboshaft too; `none` is for a type with no engine.

wake-turbulence-category.description: ICAO's wake turbulence category. Left out until it has been compiled for the row.

sources.description: The ids of the sources the row's facts come from.

checked-against.description: The ids of the row's sources someone has read for this row. A type certificate data sheet here makes the row confirmed.

notes.description: What the row covers and what is left to check.

source-notes.description: A note about one of the row's sources, by its id.

notes.description: Why it is not to be used, and how to choose what replaces it.
